title: Add RecipeScale enum with apply helpers
description: Create RecipeScale.swift defining a Scale enum with four cases (half = 0.5×, one = 1×, two = 2×, three = 3×). Add apply(to: Quantity?) → String? that scales .number values (whole-number results omit trailing zeros; fractional results use up to two decimal places), passes .text values through unchanged, and returns nil for a nil quantity. Add apply(toServings: String) → String that parses the string as an integer, multiplies by the factor, rounds to the nearest whole (minimum 1), and returns the original string unchanged when unparseable. All scaling math stays in the view layer; CookbookCore is not modified.
acceptance_criteria: Scale enum has exactly four cases covering 0.5×, 1×, 2×, 3×.
apply(to:) with .text("a pinch") returns "a pinch" unchanged for any factor.
apply(to:) with nil quantity returns nil.
